x-m-m1-10.title: Frequency buru ibu ọ̀ pụtara na ha mere nke ọma?
x-m-m1-10.goal: Mụta nsogbu nke itụnyere frequencies dịka ha dị mgbe klaasị abụọ nwere ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche, ma kewaa ihe tebụl na-enye gị ohere ikwu n'ụzọ doro anya na ihe ọ naghị enye.
x-m-m1-10.material:
Klaasị 1 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 20) na Klaasị 2 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 50) mere otu nnwale mgbakọ na mwepụ. Frequency distribution table nke akara kewara n'oke atọ bụ nke a.
Oke / Klaasị 1 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 20) / Klaasị 2 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 50)
N'okpuru akara 60 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 2 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 10
Akara 60 ma ọ bụ karịa ma n'okpuru akara 80 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 10 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 25
Akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa / ụmụ akwụkwọ 8 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 15
Minji kwuru, "E nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ karịa nwere akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa n'Klaasị 2, 15, ya mere Klaasị 2 mere nke ọma karịa n'nnwale ahụ."

x-m-m1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee ma nhọrọ ọ bụla na-eji ozi na-anọghị n'tebụl (dịka nkezi) n'nkwubi okwu ya.

x-m-m1-10.s.s1.r.a: Ị kewara site n'ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke klaasị ọ bụla ma tụnyere òkè ndị ahụ.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.r.d: Ị kewara site n'ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke klaasị ọ bụla ma tụnyere òkè ndị ahụ.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.o.b: Nkezi akara nke Klaasị 2 dị elu karịa nke Klaasị 1
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.r.b: N'tebụl nwere oke e kewara, ị pụghị ịmata nkezi kpọmkwem, n'ihi na ị maghị akara dị n'ime oke ọ bụla.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.o.c: E nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ karịa nwere akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa n'Klaasị 2, ya mere Klaasị 2 mere nke ọma karịa n'nnwale ahụ
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.r.c: Ị tụnyere klaasị abụọ nwere ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche site n'iji ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ naanị. Lelee ọzọ n'okwu nke ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.o.d: Òkè nke ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa dị elu n'Klaasị 1 karịa n'Klaasị 2
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.explain: N'okwu nke òkè, maka akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa, Klaasị 1 nwere 8/20=40% ma Klaasị 2 nwere 15/50=30%, ya mere Klaasị 1 dị elu; maka n'okpuru akara 60, Klaasị 1 nwere 2/20=10% ma Klaasị 2 nwere 10/50=20%, ya mere Klaasị 2 bụ okpukpu 2 nke Klaasị 1. Enweghị ike ịmata nkezi site n'tebụl nwere oke e kewara, nkwubi okwu na-atụnyere naanị ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nwekwara nkwado adịghị ike.

x-m-m1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị gosiri na nkwubi okwu Minji nwere ike ịtụgharị?
x-m-m1-10.s.s2.model.0: Klaasị ndị ahụ nwere ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche, ya mere anyị ekwesịghị itụnyere site n'iji ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ naanị. Maka akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa, Klaasị 1 nwere 8÷20=40% ma Klaasị 2 nwere 15÷50=30%, ya mere Klaasị 1 dị elu.
x-m-m1-10.s.s2.model.1: Klaasị 1 nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 8 n'ime 20 n'ngụkọta, ma Klaasị 2 nwere 15 n'ime 50 n'ngụkọta. N'okwu nke relative frequency, ha bụ 0.4 na 0.3, ya mere Klaasị 1 dị elu n'ezie.

x-m-m1-08.title: Ịgụ eserese ịdị elu mmiri nke ebe mebere

x-m-m1-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaa ajụjụ ahụ oge ọ bụla a kpughere ebe. Ọ dị mma ma ịkọ ihe gị gara aga gbanwere.

x-m-m1-03.title: Ịnwale nkwupụta “ọnụọgụ dị nta nwekwara absolute value dị nta”
x-m-m1-03.goal: Mepụta ihe atụ na-agbagha izugbe gbasara absolute value na nhazi nha, chọta ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ.
x-m-m1-03.material: Seoyun kwuru, “N’ime ọnụọgụ abụọ, nke dị nta nwekwara absolute value dị nta. 3<7, |3|=3, |7|=7, ya mere 3<7, ọ̀ bụ eziokwu?” (A na-agụ |a| “absolute value nke a,” ọ bụkwa anya dị n’etiti 0 na a n’ahịrị ọnụọgụ.)
x-m-m1-03.thinking.2: Ịchọta ọnọdụ ọ ga-eji bụrụ eziokwu
x-m-m1-03.prereq.0: Ebe integer na rational nọ n’ahịrị ọnụọgụ
x-m-m1-03.prereq.1: Ihe absolute value pụtara (anya site na 0)
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.prompt: Mepụta ihe atụ na-emegide nkwupụta Seoyun site na ụzọ ọnụọgụ abụọ (a,b) ebe a<b ma |a| karịrị |b|. Ị chọrọ ihe atụ abụọ ebe akara b dị iche (dị mma, 0, na-adịghị mma), dịka otu b dị mma na otu b adịghị mma.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ nwalee ihe na-eme mgbe a karịrị 0.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Chee n’akụkụ 0 a ga-adị n’ahịrị ọnụọgụ, họrọzie b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.ok.c2: Absolute value nke a karịrị nke b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.fail.c2: Absolute value nke a anaghị akarị nke b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.explain: a ga-abụ nke na-adịghị mma. Ihe atụ: (−5,2) nwere −5<2 ma |−5|=5>|2|=2; (−5,−2) nwekwara −5<−2 ma 5>2. Ihe atụ ebe b dị mma na nke na-adịghị mma abụọ ahụ ga-ekwe omume. (2 5)
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.prompt: Họrọ otu ihe atụ i chọtara, kọwaa ihe mere nkwupụta Seoyun ji ezighi ezi.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.hint.0: Dee ọnụọgụ abụọ nke ihe atụ i họọrọ na absolute value ha n’akụkụ ibe ha.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.hint.1: Chee ole ihe atụ na-agbagha ka achọrọ iji mebie okwu “mgbe niile.”
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: N’ihe atụ i họọrọ, a<b ọ̀ bụ eziokwu n’ezie?
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: I gosiri na nha absolute value na-abụghị otu usoro ahụ nkwupụta Seoyun kwuru?
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.model.0: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, −5<2, ma absolute value nke −5 bụ 5, nke karịrị absolute value nke 2 bụ 2; ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi. Otu ihe atụ na-agbagha ezuola ime ka “mgbe niile” bụrụ ụgha.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.model.1: −3<−1, ma |−3|=3, |−1|=1; ya mere absolute value adịghị nta. N’ihi ọnọdụ a, nkwupụta ahụ anaghị arụ ọrụ.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.prompt: Mgbe ole ka anyị nwere ike ikwu “ọ bụrụ a<b, mgbe ahụ |a|<|b|” n’ezie?
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu ọnụọgụ mezuru ọnọdụ nke nhọrọ ọ bụla, lelee ma ihe atụ na-agbagha gara aga nwere ike ịdị n’okpuru ọnọdụ ahụ.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ihe atụ na-agbagha nwere ike ịdị n’okpuru ọnọdụ ahụ, ọ naghị emezu “aghaghị ịbụ eziokwu.”
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.o.a: Mgbe ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ adịghị mma
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.a: Maka ọnụọgụ na-adịghị mma, nhazi ha na-atụgharị n’ezie. −5<−2, ma absolute value ha bụ 5>2.

x-m-m1-02.material: Minseo chọtara greatest common divisor nke 36 na 60 site na prime factorization, dee ngwọta dị n’okpuru. (2² pụtara 2 squared, 3² pụtara 3 squared.)

x-m-m1-02.prereq.1: Ihe common divisor na greatest common divisor pụtara

x-m-m1-01.title: Ịchọta ọnụọgụ nwere divisor 12
x-m-m1-01.goal: Chọpụta otú e si emepụta divisors site n’ụdị prime factorization, chọta ọtụtụ ọnụọgụ mezuru ọnọdụ ma lelee ha.
x-m-m1-01.material:
E kewara ọnụọgụ N n’ime prime factors, naanị prime factors ya bụ 2 na 3. Ya mere N bụ ngwaahịa “2 mụbara ugboro a” na “3 mụbara ugboro b” (a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dịkarịa ala 1).
Dịka ọmụmaatụ, 12=2²×3 (2 mụbara ugboro abụọ, 3 ugboro otu). Ọ bụrụ na anyị dee divisors 12 (1,2,3,4,6,12) dịka “ugboro ole e mụbara 2, ugboro ole e mụbara 3,” nke a bụ ndepụta.
Divisor 1: 2 ugboro 0, 3 ugboro 0 / Divisor 2: 1 ugboro, 0 / Divisor 4: 2 ugboro, 0 / Divisor 3: 0 ugboro, 1 / Divisor 6: 1, 1 / Divisor 12: 2, 1. (1 12 2 3 4 6)
